name.ja: 30MM オプションパーツセット ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 05
name.en: 30MM Option parts set ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON WEAPON SET 05

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE Ⅵ FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、展開状態を再現可能なパルスブレードを含めた武器群をセットで商品化。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," we have commercialized a set of weapons, including a pulse blade that can be recreated in its deployed state.
• The contents of the weapon are "RF-024 TURNER ", " HI-32: BU-TT/A ", " BML-G1/P07VTC-12 ", and " SI-24: SU-Q5".

description.ja: • 装備する際に左右で形状が変わる武装は再現用のパーツがそれぞれ付属し、選択式で組み立てが可能。
description.en: • Weapons that change shape on the left and right when equipped come with parts for reproduction, and can be assembled selectively.

description.ja: • 「HI-32：BU-TT/A」のパルスブレードの展開状態をパーツの差し替えで再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the expanded state of the pulse blade of "HI-32: BU-TT/A" by replacing parts.

description.ja: • 「SI-24：SU-Q5」のパルスシールドの展開状態を再現可能なPETシートが付属。
description.en: • A PET sheet that can reproduce the deployment state of the pulse seal of "SI-24:SU-Q5" is included.
